payload.body_they: {{Name}} can do very well inside a structure and still feel constrained by how much was decided before they had any say in it. They may keep trying to earn freedom through stronger work, more responsibility, or more recognition. Sometimes that works. Other times the same restriction survives every accomplishment. What matters is what recognition actually gives them. Praise means more when it comes with enough authority for their judgment to change something.
